props.name: id
props.description:
The id for the root element id attribute.
If the prop is not set a random value will be generated.

props.name: isOpen
props.description:
If the modal is open.
Use this to toggle if the modal should be visible or not.

props.name: ariaCloseText
props.description: The aria-label attribute text for the top right close button.

props.name: type
props.description: The type of modal. 'information', 'warning' and 'error' is valid.

props.name: size
props.description: The size of modal in desktop mode.

props.name: focus
props.description:
Default behavior is that the modal will restore focus to previous element once closed.
- "on" (default) - component will set focus both when opened and closed
- "off" - focus strategy disabled
- "open" - focus will only be applied once modal is opened

events.name: close
events.description:
Event that is dispatched when the escape button is pressed.
In most use cases the `isOpen` prop should be set to false when this event is triggered.

slots.name: content
slots.description: Slot for the main content, e.g. paragraphs, input fields, etc.

slots.name: footer
slots.description: Slot the footer content, i.e. buttons.
